questions.q: What percentage of the qualification is the Appraising (listening) paper?
questions.why: Appraising is 40%; Performing and Composing are 30% each.

questions.q: Which set work is in the area of study Fusions?
options: John Williams: Star Wars Main Title
questions.why: Release and Samba Em Preludio are the Fusions set works.

questions.q: In a 4-mark listening question, how many separate points should you aim to give?
questions.why: Roughly one point per mark, each with a musical term and evidence.

questions.q: Give two things you should do to answer a listening question well.
questions.model: Underline the element the question asks about, then use a specific musical term with evidence from the extract.
points: read the question and identify the element
